steps.what: List the other crew already named for lighting, costumes, and props.
Work with crew members responsible for those departments.
Confirm the prop and the costume before the scene.

tasks.design: Crew already named for lighting, costumes, makeup, and props are listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor works with those members. A department with no name is not listed. The list does not fit a costume or set a light.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actor asked on the day who was responsible for the prop.
tasks.enabler_now: A crew member already named can be listed before the actor arrives.
tasks.still_hard: The fitting and the light, which are done with the person, not from the name.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can see that the named costume still does not work for the scene.
tasks.altitude: Named crew can be listed. The actor still works with them on lighting, costumes, makeup, and props.

reach.task: Be named on the call, and still do the work with the actor.
reach.learn: The name can be listed. The work stays here.

evidence.claim: A crew member already named for lighting, costumes, or props can be listed. The list cannot do that work.
The actor works with the crew. A name on a call is not a fitting and it is not a lighting decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Crew id and department, produced by the call already published. A department with no name is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the call the company already publishes.
unknowns: Which fittings happen only on the day.
research_questions: What share of crew are named before the day?
Which props are still unset at call time?

already_counted.description: The actor still works with the crew.
The actor still confirms the prop and the costume.

incremental.description: The actor finds a crew name the call did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing crew already named for lighting, costumes, and props. It disappears when the name is missing and the actor finds it. Working with the crew stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List production facts already cleared for an interview.
Promote productions using interviews about plays or movies.
Correct a public line the interview did not actually give.

tasks.design: Production facts already cleared are listed from {DOCS} before an interview. The actor promotes the play or the movie in the interview. A fact that is not cleared is not listed. The sheet does not give the interview. A public line is corrected only by the actor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interview facts were remembered, and a date that had changed was sometimes still said.
tasks.enabler_now: A fact already cleared can be listed before the interview.
tasks.still_hard: The interview itself, and a question the cleared facts do not answer.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can refuse to say a fact the sheet cleared and the production has since changed.
tasks.altitude: Cleared facts can be listed. The actor still gives the interview. A public line the interview did not give is not left standing.

reach.task: Use a fact already cleared, and still leave the interview with the actor.
reach.learn: The fact sheet can be shared. The interview stays here.

evidence.claim: A production fact already cleared can be listed before an interview. The list cannot promote the production or give the interview.
The actor speaks. A fact that is not cleared is not used. If a desk answered the public, it would have to say it is not the actor. This task does not do that.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Fact id and a cleared flag, produced by the production file. A fact that is not cleared is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the production file the company already keeps. Do not post an interview the actor did not give.
research_questions: What share of interviews start from a cleared fact?
Which questions have no cleared answer?

already_counted.description: The actor still gives the interview.
The actor still corrects a public line.

incremental.description: The actor clears a fact the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing production facts already cleared for an interview. It disappears when the fact is not cleared and the actor clears it. Giving the interview stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the comedy spot already given in the running order.
Tell jokes and perform comic dances, songs, and skits to amuse audiences.
Contort, impersonate mannerisms and voices of others, and use other devices.

tasks.design: A comedy spot already in the running order is listed from {CALENDAR}. The actor tells the jokes, performs the songs, dances, and skits, and impersonates voices. A spot with no id is not listed. The list does not perform.
tasks.previous_blocker: The spot number was shouted from the side as the actor walked on.
tasks.enabler_now: A spot already in the running order can be listed before the actor goes on.
tasks.still_hard: The joke, the song, and the voice, which the actor performs.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can drop a joke the order lists when the room is not ready for it.
tasks.altitude: A listed spot can be known in advance. The actor still performs the comedy.

reach.task: Know the spot in the order, and still perform the number.
reach.learn: The spot can be listed. The performance stays here.

evidence.claim: A comedy spot already in the running order can be listed. The list cannot tell a joke, sing, dance, or impersonate a voice.
The performance is the actor's. A running order is not a routine.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.
Fields: Spot id, produced by the running order already set. A spot with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the order the company already keeps. The actor performs.
unknowns: Which spots are already in the order.
Which bits are dropped on the night.
research_questions: What share of spots are in the order before the show?
Which jokes are added in the room?

already_counted.description: The actor still performs the jokes, songs, and skits.
The actor still impersonates and uses the other devices.

incremental.description: The actor confirms a spot the order did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing a comedy spot already in the running order. It disappears when the spot is missing and the actor confirms it. Telling the jokes and performing the songs, dances, and skits stay with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List scenes already marked in the source for an adaptation.
Write original or adapted material for dramas and other performances.
Review comedies, narration, and puppet shows before anyone else uses them.

tasks.design: Scenes already marked in a source the actor is allowed to adapt are listed from {DOCS}. The actor writes the original material or the adaptation, including drama, comedy, narration, and puppet shows. An unmarked scene is not listed. The list does not write the scene, and generated text is not published in place of the writing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The actor copied scenes by hand from a source before writing a word of the adaptation.
tasks.enabler_now: A scene already marked in a source the actor may use can be listed before the writing.
tasks.still_hard: The writing, which is the actor's, including what to leave out.
tasks.human_edge: The actor can see a marked scene and decide it should not be in this piece.
tasks.altitude: Marked scenes can be listed. The actor still writes the original or the adaptation. Generated text is not published in place of that writing.

reach.task: Keep the authorship. A marked scene is not the adaptation.
reach.learn: The scene list can be shared. The writing stays here.

evidence.claim: A scene already marked in a source can be listed. The list cannot write an original scene or an adaptation.

The actor writes the material and reviews it before anyone else uses it. Text and data mining of a source is allowed only where the rightholder has not reserved it. Generated text published to inform the public would have to be disclosed unless a person reviewed it under editorial responsibility. This task does not publish generated text in place of the writing.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An actor in a mid-size European company or company of players. A call sheet does not audition, rehearse, or perform. A list does not rank who is seen.

Fields: Scene id, produced by marks in a source the actor is already allowed to adapt. An unmarked scene, or a source whose rightholder has reserved mining, is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the actor finishes it by hand.
Native check: The actor writes the material. Do not publish generated text in its place.
unknowns: Which sources the actor is allowed to adapt.
research_questions: What share of adaptations start from a marked scene?
Which pieces are written with no source list?

already_counted.description: The actor still writes the material.
The actor still reviews it before use.

incremental.description: The actor clears a source the list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing scenes already marked in a source the actor may adapt. It disappears when the scene is unmarked, or the source is reserved, and the actor does not use it. Writing the original or the adaptation stays with the actor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The actor still works with the crew, still gives the interview, still performs the comedy, and still writes the material. A named crew or a marked scene can be listed. The actor writes. Generated text is not published in place of that writing.
reach: Audio and video technicians are named on the call, and this job learns the actor still works with them.
Poets, lyricists and creative writers keep the authorship, and this job learns a marked scene is not an adaptation.
skills_to_grow: Write the original or the adaptation. Do not publish generated text in its place.
Give the interview. A fact sheet is not the promotion.
role.ambitious_version: Named crew and marked scenes are listed first. The crew work, the interview, the comedy, and the writing stay with the actor.
